title: Drive API: Permission Concurrency Warning Clarified
summary: The Google Drive API documentation for permission management methods has been updated to provide a more explicit warning regarding concurrent modifications across files, folders, and shared drives.
details: The `permissions.create`, `permissions.delete`, and `permissions.update` methods now feature an enhanced warning in their descriptions. The updated text clarifies that 'Concurrent permission modifications (such as update or delete) on the same file, folder, or shared drive aren't supported across any users or clients; only the last update is applied.' This makes the existing behavior warning more comprehensive, explicitly including folders and shared drives, and emphasizing the client-agnostic nature of the limitation. This is a documentation clarification and does not represent a change in API behavior.
